question: A conical bucket is cut at one-third its height from the top. What is the ratio of the volumes of the two parts (top part to bottom part)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a cone is cut parallel to its base, the volumes of the corresponding parts are proportional to the cubes of their heights.

Ratio of heights of top cone to total cone = 1 : 3.

Ratio of volumes of top cone to total cone = 1³ : 3³ = 1 : 27.

Volume of bottom part = Total volume − Top volume = 27 − 1 = 26 units.

Ratio of volumes of top part to bottom part = 1 : 26.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A conical bucket is cut at one-third of its height from the top.

Let total height of the cone be H and base radius be R.

Height of the top cone (h) = H / 3.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cone = (1/3) × π × radius² × height
